name: mappings
label: Mappings
description: List of objects with data about each mapped object (including both pills and text)

name: allTargetFields
label: All target fields
description: List of all target fields, used in the dropdown for selecting fields

name: enableFieldSelection
label: Enable field selection
description: If true, this target field is customizable, so that the user is able to select which field this entity field editor represents. If this is set, then `allTargetFields` is required, as this is the dropdown items.

name: showPillPicker
label: showPillPicker
description: Determines if display the source pill picker or not

name: showPillFx
label: showPillFx
description: Determines if display the fx button in each pill

name: useGrid
label: Use grid
description: When true, this single editor will act as a row in a CSS grid system.
